1699.q1_discovery: Generates +29.15 runs above expected per 100 balls in high pressure (250 HP balls across 16 matches), striking at 196.4 vs Pace (138b) and 175.0 vs Spin (112b).
1699.q2_significance: True all-phase 360° chaser whose boundary rate does not decay against high pace or spin. Post-dot SR is 154.2 with a 12.5% dismissal rate (95% CI: [5.9%, 24.7%]).
1699.q3_rr_implication: Benchmark reference standard for RR chase modeling; illustrates the ideal boundary-access distribution for middle-order chasers.
1699.q4_scouting_decision: IPL 2027 Status: PENDING_RETENTION (Mumbai Indians). Inaccessible in auction; serves as the quantitative template for scouting domestic middle-order chasers.

1077.q1_discovery: Records a 1.85% post-dot dismissal rate under high pressure (1 wkt in 54 opps across 19 matches, 95% CI: [0.3%, 9.8%]), striking at 187.3 vs Spin (118b) and 169.3 vs Pace (202b).
1077.q2_significance: Statistically verified resilience against dot-ball panic compared to league baseline (1.85% vs 8.11%), without sacrificing scoring rate (153.7 post-dot SR).
1077.q3_rr_implication: Exemplifies the ideal tactical profile for RR's middle-order crunch chases when early wickets fall at high-scoring venues.
1077.q4_scouting_decision: IPL 2027 Status: PENDING_RETENTION (Delhi Capitals - pre-retention status pending BCCI Nov 17 deadline). High-priority overseas trade or auction target if released.

7260.q1_discovery: Maintains 0 observed post-dot dismissals across 20 high-pressure opportunities (9 matches; 95% Wilson CI: [0.0%, 16.1%]), striking at 195.8 vs Pace (71b) and 197.7 vs Spin (43b).
7260.q2_significance: Demonstrates symmetric scoring mastery across pace and spin. While 0 dismissals were observed in this sample, statistical uncertainty allows for an underlying risk up to 16.1%.
7260.q3_rr_implication: Home-grown Rajasthan Royals core asset (+24.88 HP runs/100b); validates RR's internal player development in high-pressure finishing.
7260.q4_scouting_decision: IPL 2027 Status: RR_2026_SQUAD (Rajasthan Royals). Designated primary #6 finisher and wicket-keeping clutch asset; official franchise retention announcement pending BCCI November 17 declarations.

2258.q1_discovery: Strikes at 227.3 vs Spin under high pressure (33 balls faced, 33.3% boundary rate). Post-dot sample is limited (12 opps across 4 matches; 0 dismissals, 95% CI: [0.0%, 24.2%]).
2258.q2_significance: Lethal spin-disruptor in high-pressure chases, relieving required-run-rate stress. Post-dot sample size (N=12) is formally classified as Insufficient Evidence (< 15 opps) for composure.
2258.q3_rr_implication: Elite Indian keeper-batter with lethal spin-hitting dominance (+227.3 SR); would provide tactical mastery at turning venues if re-acquired.
2258.q4_scouting_decision: IPL 2027 Status: PENDING_RETENTION (Chennai Super Kings). External franchise contract; high-priority acquisition target only if released by CSK into the auction pool (BCCI Nov 17 retention declarations pending).

8101.q1_discovery: Delivers +23.15 runs/100b under peak pressure (168 balls across 17 matches), striking at 190.6 vs Pace (117b) with 0 observed post-dot dismissals across 33 opps (12 matches; 95% CI: [0.0%, 10.4%]).
8101.q2_significance: Strong statistical evidence of lower-order boundary striking against express pace. The 0/33 post-dot record confirms composure, with statistical upper-bound risk capped at 10.4%.
8101.q3_rr_implication: Addresses RR's tactical need for domestic lower-order death hitting depth behind Hetmyer and Jurel, preserving overseas slots for specialist bowling.
8101.q4_scouting_decision: IPL 2027 Status: PENDING_RETENTION (Delhi Capitals - pre-retention status pending Nov 17 declarations). High-priority domestic acquisition candidate if released into auction.

6396.q1_discovery: Strikes at 190.3 vs Pace in high pressure (217b), but drops to 141.3 vs Spin (75b), with an 8.96% post-dot dismissal rate (6 wkts in 67 opps, 95% CI: [4.2%, 18.2%]).
6396.q2_significance: Extreme pace specialist with measurable spin vulnerability (49-point SR drop) and an aggressive boundary-or-out composure profile.
6396.q3_rr_implication: Valuable death finisher on pace-friendly tracks, but requires tactical shielding against quality mystery spin.
6396.q4_scouting_decision: IPL 2027 Status: PENDING_RETENTION (Royal Challengers Bengaluru - pending retention declarations). Secondary overseas targeting option conditional on complementary spin-hitting presence and auction release.

7897.q1_discovery: Generates a 245.5 SR on deliveries following a dot ball under high pressure (44 opps across 18 matches, 36.4% boundary response, 2.27% dismissal rate [95% CI: 0.4%, 11.9%]).
7897.q2_significance: Statistically robust immediate counter-punch response; reverses dot-ball pressure with positive intent while keeping dismissals well below league baseline (2.27% vs 8.11%).
7897.q3_rr_implication: High-composure left-handed accumulator-accelerator who provides structural stability between overs 7 and 17.
7897.q4_scouting_decision: IPL 2027 Status: PENDING_RETENTION (Mumbai Indians). Unlikely to be released; serves as the domestic benchmark for evaluating left-handed middle-order chasers.

2933.q1_discovery: Concedes only 6.00 RPO on deliveries following a boundary (217 opps across 71 matches), allowing only 10.1% repeat boundaries (95% CI: [6.8%, 14.9%]) with a 44.2% dot rebound (95% CI: [37.8%, 50.9%]).
2933.q2_significance: Overwhelming statistical evidence of unrivaled tactical reset capability (less than half league repeat boundary rate of 22.8%; +9.6% dot rebound above baseline).
2933.q3_rr_implication: The gold standard of T20 bowling; demonstrates that true elite bowling is defined by post-boundary lockdown.
2933.q4_scouting_decision: IPL 2027 Status: PENDING_RETENTION (Mumbai Indians). Untouchable national marquee asset; serves as benchmark template for evaluating death bowling targets.

7920.q1_discovery: Maintains 7.90 RPO post-boundary economy across 126 opps (41 matches), with a 16.7% repeat boundary rate (95% CI: [11.2%, 24.1%]) and 6.35% rebound wicket rate (95% CI: [3.3%, 12.0%]). Death economy is 8.35 RPO.
7920.q2_significance: Statistically verified death overs yorker technician whose execution suppresses boundary clusters (16.7% vs league 22.8%) while maintaining above-average strike capability.
7920.q3_rr_implication: Serves as an analytical benchmark for post-boundary death bowling composure (7.90 post-boundary RPO, 16.7% repeat boundary rate).
7920.q4_scouting_decision: IPL 2027 Status: CONFIRMED_OTHER_TEAM (Sunrisers Hyderabad - confirmed trade TR-2027-04). Automatically hard-excluded from Rajasthan Royals actionable auction targets.

781.q1_discovery: Saves +0.64 runs/over under pressure (#1 overall bowler), conceding 7.97 RPO post-boundary across 137 opps (59 matches) with a 16.8% repeat boundary rate (95% CI: [11.5%, 23.9%]).
781.q2_significance: Elite restrictive mystery spin profile; suppresses scoring across both RHB (6.52 Econ) and LHB (7.15 Econ) and eliminates boundary clusters.
781.q3_rr_implication: Proves the value of restrictive spin in shifting win probability; reinforces RR's venue strategy at spin-friendly Guwahati.
781.q4_scouting_decision: IPL 2027 Status: PENDING_RETENTION (Kolkata Knight Riders). Franchise icon; illustrates the archetype for RR's secondary mystery spinner search.

4641.q1_discovery: Produces a 43.8% dot ball rate (95% CI: [35.8%, 52.2%]) and 7.30% wicket rate (95% CI: [4.0%, 12.9%]) post-boundary across 137 opps (37 matches), conceding 8.19 RPO.
4641.q2_significance: Aggressive hit-the-deck rebound bowler who responds to boundaries by attacking the stumps and generating dots (+9.2% above league baseline).
4641.q3_rr_implication: High-value overseas pace alternative whose hard-length execution suits the bouncy, true-carrying pitches at SMS Jaipur.
4641.q4_scouting_decision: IPL 2027 Status: PENDING_RETENTION (Delhi Capitals - pre-retention status pending Nov 17 declarations). Strong value-for-money acquisition candidate if released.
